description: This Swift file defines UI components and caching mechanisms for session preview items in a macOS application. It includes structs, enums, actors for caching and limiting concurrent preview requests, and a SwiftUI View for displaying session previews. It also contains logic for fetching, caching, and processing session preview data, including handling timeouts and error scenarios.

classes.name: SessionPreviewCache
classes.description: An actor managing cached session preview snapshots with time-based validation.

classes.name: SessionPreviewLimiter
classes.description: An actor controlling the number of concurrent preview requests to limit resource usage.

methods.name: prewarm
methods.description: Preloads session previews for a list of session keys.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a session preview snapshot for a given session key, using cache if available.

methods.name: fetchSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches a snapshot of session preview data, with fallback logic.

methods.name: requestPreview
methods.description: Requests preview data from the server with timeout handling.

methods.name: fetchHistorySnapshot
methods.description: Fetches historical chat data when preview request fails with an unknown method error.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a SessionMenuPreviewSnapshot from a list of items or an entry.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Stores preview payloads into the cache.

methods.name: previewLimit
methods.description: Calculates the limit for preview items based on maxItems.

methods.name: normalizeMaxItems
methods.description: Ensures maxItems value is within acceptable bounds.

methods.name: previewItems
methods.description: Builds preview items from different payloads.

methods.name: decodeMessages
methods.description: Decodes raw message data into message objects.

methods.name: previewRole
methods.description: Determines the role of a message for preview purposes.

methods.name: previewRoleFromRaw
methods.description: Converts raw role strings into PreviewRole enum.

methods.name: previewText
methods.description: Extracts display text from chat messages for preview.

methods.name: isToolCall
methods.description: Checks if a message involves a tool call.

methods.name: toolNames
methods.description: Extracts tool names mentioned in a message.

methods.name: mediaSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary for media content in messages.

methods.name: dedupePreservingOrder
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries from a list while maintaining order.

methods.name: uniqueKeys
methods.description: Deduplicates and trims whitespace from session keys.

methods.name: isUnknownMethodError
methods.description: Checks if an error corresponds to an unknown method server response.
